items.titleEn: U18s report: Norwich City 1-5 Arsenal
items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners soared past the Canaries to secure their third win in a row
bodyEn: Our young Gunners continued their fine form with a third U18 Premier League South victory in a row, after a 5-1 demolition of Norwich City.
A scintillating first 45 saw us hit four past the home side, as Axel Donczew opened the floodgates before Jaden Maghoma struck twice and Charlie Purdy completed the scoring before the interval.
Ollie Roberson reduced the deficit after the restart but Emerson Nwaneri added a late fifth to ensure we finished on a high and secured another victory to continue our strong start to the campaign
FIRST HALF

We continued our recent trend of starting games quickly and took the lead inside 15 minutes when Donczew picked up the ball on the edge of the box, drove towards goal and expertly found the far corner.

With our foot on the accelerator, we doubled our lead after the half-hour mark through excellent work by Nwaneri, who used close control to weave past a pair of Norwich defenders before sending a wonderful ball across goal for Maghoma to tap home.
Maghoma delivered our third just moments later, after Teshaun Murisa benefitted from good combination play down the left flank, beating two City players before teeing up another simple finish.
Our fourth arrived before the break as Donczew won his duel to venture into the Canaries' box, composed himself and cut the ball back for Purdy, who finished unchallenged.
SECOND HALF

The Norfolk side got one back early in the second half when Kahlil Steele intercepted Daniel McCarron’s pass, worked the ball to the byline and found Roberson in the area, whose shot took a deflection on its way past Charlie Phillips.

In stoppage time, Nwaneri capped off a five-star display in East Anglia, picked out by Luis Munoz following excellent work out wide. A clever feint sent his opponent the wrong way before he smashed the ball into the bottom corner.
WHAT IT MEANS
The result makes it three wins on the bounce and sees us climb to fifth in the table, with 10 points from our opening six games.
WHAT'S NEXT
We return to U18 Premier League Cup action at home to Birmingham City on Saturday, October 10.
Kick-off at the Sobha Realty Training Centre is scheduled for 12pm (UK time).
LINE-UPS
Norwich City XI: Darbyshire-Came, Glossop (Akarakiri 61), Oldfield, Augusto, Munikwa (Leech 61), Collins, Kipa (Crane 45), Duffy, Edwards (Allen 61), Roberson (Goodson 71), Steele (Cork 84).
Subs: Bullen.
Arsenal XI: C.Phillips, Sampang, Abubakar, McCarron (Owusu-Gyasi 76), Stachow, Purdy (Odaji-Ukueku 63), Munoz, Murisa (Yetna 90+2), Maghoma (Bernard 45), Nwaneri, Donczew (B. Phillips 63).
Subs: Lo Presti, van der Straaten.

items.titleZh: U18梯队战报：诺维奇城 1-5 阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 年轻的枪手大胜金丝雀，取得三连胜。
bodyZh: 年轻的枪手延续了良好状态，在U18英超南部联赛中以5-1大胜诺维奇城，收获三连胜。
在上半场精彩的前45分钟里，我们在客场攻入四球。阿克塞尔-东切夫率先打破僵局，随后贾登-马戈马梅开二度，查理-珀迪在半场结束前再下一城。
下半场易边再战后，奥利-罗伯逊为诺维奇扳回一城，但埃默森-恩瓦内里在比赛尾声阶段攻入第五球，确保我们以一场大胜完美收官，延续了本赛季的良好开局。
上半场
我们延续了近期开局迅猛的势头，开场不到15分钟便取得领先。当时东切夫在禁区边缘拿球，带球推进并冷静射门打入远角。
我们持续加速，在比赛进行到半小时后扩大了领先优势。恩瓦内里表现出色，他通过细腻的盘带突破了两名诺维奇防守球员，随后送出一脚精妙的横传，助攻马戈马轻松推射破门。
仅仅片刻之后，马戈马便打入了我们的第三球。此前特肖恩-穆里萨在左路通过精妙配合突破了两名诺维奇球员，随后为队友送上又一次轻松破门的机会。
在上半场结束前，我们攻入了第四球。东切夫赢得对抗杀入禁区，调整好节奏后将球回敲，珀迪无人盯防轻松推射得分。
下半场
诺维奇在下半场开局不久扳回一城。卡利尔-斯蒂尔拦截了丹尼尔-麦卡隆的传球，将球带至底线附近并传给禁区内的罗伯逊，罗伯逊的射门经折射后越过了查理-菲利普斯。
在伤停补时阶段，恩瓦内里为这场在东安格利亚的大胜画上句号。他在接到路易斯-穆尼奥斯在边路的精妙传球后，用一个聪明的假动作晃过防守球员，随后将球轰入底角。
积分榜形势
这场胜利让我们取得了三连胜，积分榜排名上升至第五位，在前六场比赛中积10分。
赛程预告
我们将于10月10日星期六重返U18英超杯赛场，主场迎战伯明翰城。
比赛将于英国时间中午12点在索布哈-里尔蒂训练基地开球。

替补：布伦。

items.titleEn: Team news: Guimaraes and Timber start at Brighton
items.summaryEn: Find out the team Mikel Arteta has selected to face Brighton on the south coast
bodyEn: Bruno Guimaraes and Jurrien Timber both come into the side make their first Premier League starts of the season for our trip to Brighton.

They are the only two changes from the team that started our last league game, the 2-0 win away to Sunderland last weekend. Ben White started that match, but misses out entirely today with injury, with Myles Lewis-Skelly also moving to the bench to make way for Guimaraes.
It’s Timber first start since we beat Everton back in March, while Guimaraes earns his first Premier League start for us following his stunning goal at the Stadium of Light.

Declan Rice was rested in the Carabao Cup in midweek, but starts today, with Martin Odegaard also in midfield. Bukayo Saka and Christos Tzolis line up either side of Kai Havertz for the fifth consecutive time in the league this season.
Max Dowman – double goalscorer against Ipswich Town on Tuesday – is among the substitutes, and Piero Hincapie is also fit enough for selection on the bench.

items.titleZh: 球队新闻：吉马良斯与廷贝尔首发对阵布莱顿
items.summaryZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔公布了客场对阵布莱顿的首发阵容。
bodyZh: 布鲁诺·吉马良斯和于尔恩·廷贝尔双双进入首发阵容，迎来了他们本赛季在英超联赛中的首次先发，随队客场挑战布莱顿。
这是球队对上一场联赛首发阵容仅有的两处调整，上周末阿森纳在客场2-0击败了桑德兰。本·怀特在那场比赛中首发，但今天因伤缺阵，迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利也回到了替补席，为吉马良斯腾出位置。
这是廷贝尔自三月份击败埃弗顿以来的首次首发，而吉马良斯在光明球场打入精彩进球后，也迎来了他在阿森纳的英超首秀首发。
德克兰·赖斯在周中的联赛杯中得到轮休，但今天重回首发，马丁·厄德高也坐镇中场。布卡约·萨卡和克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯将连续第五场联赛在 Kai Havertz 两翼搭档。
周二对阵伊普斯维奇梅开二度的马克斯·道德曼进入了替补名单，皮埃罗·因卡皮耶也伤愈复出进入替补席。
阵容

items.titleEn: Read Renée's Manchester United programme notes
items.summaryEn: Read our head coach's thoughts ahead of the Barclays Women's Super League game at home to Manchester United
bodyEn: Before every home game, Renée Slegers gives her thoughts around the team and our upcoming game in her manager's notes published in the matchday programme.
Ahead of our Women's Super League match at home to Manchester United, the head coach says the players will be ruthless following last Sunday's goalless draw against Crystal Palace.

Hello and welcome to Emirates Stadium for what has become a key fixture in the Barclays Women’s Super League – Manchester United. And we like it even more when it is here, under the lights at our home. All of us, players and staff alike, can’t wait to get back out on the grass and show what we can do.

There was a lot of disappointment and frustration on Sunday that we’ve had to work through this week. No matter how well we played – and there were a lot of positives to take from the performance against Crystal Palace – the result is what counts at the end of the season.

We brought a lot of variety in our attack, both from set pieces and open play, but the finishing touches were missing. That wasn’t through lack of effort or intensity. There have been times in the past where panic has set in when the goals just don’t come, and I don’t believe that was the case last weekend. We didn’t stop believing we would score. From a mentality perspective, that is exactly what we need to hold on to. But we must concentrate more on the finer details to improve.

Even if you go into a game expecting to dominate possession, the reality of breaking down an opposition’s low block is never easy, especially when you face a team as well-drilled as Crystal Palace. After the full time whistle, we had to ask ourselves: were we aligned at every opportunity? Was each pass, shot and movement at the standard we expect from ourselves?

As we found last weekend and last season, draws were what held us back from achieving what we are fully capable of. There is so much that we’re already good at and so much I can already see we’re improving at, so we can’t dwell for too long on last weekend. We just have to persevere and learn.

The response I’ve seen from the girls this week is exactly what we wanted. Clinical in the final third, motivated and energetic in all of our training sessions so far. We’ve reviewed every aspect of the Palace game together and then they’ve worked so hard on the pitch. For me, there is no better opportunity to put all of these learnings into practice than against Manchester United, a side we failed to score against last season. Of course, they have a new manager this season and they’re setting up differently to how they did before, so that is a separate challenge for us to tackle. But naturally it’s a challenge we’re looking forward to. We have talked about building momentum early on in the season, and tonight is an opportunity to make sure that the result matches our performance and that we continue to build momentum as we head into a busy and important block of games.

We were all sorry that we couldn’t secure a win for all of the supporters who showed up to make such an incredible atmosphere last Sunday, and we’re even hungrier to put in a performance your support deserves tonight. Thank you for the energy you brought from start to finish last weekend. We hope you can bring the same today, because your energy and beliefs drives us forward.
Let’s make it a special evening – COYG!

items.titleZh: 阅读勒妮关于曼联比赛的赛刊手记
items.summaryZh: 阅读主教练在巴克莱女子英超主场对阵曼联比赛前的赛前感言。
bodyZh: 在每场主场比赛前，勒妮·斯勒格斯都会在比赛日赛刊中发表她的主教练手记，分享她对球队以及即将到来的比赛的看法。
在女子英超主场对阵曼联的比赛前，这位主教练表示，在经历上周日与水晶宫的互交白卷后，球员们将在门前表现得更加冷酷。
大家好，欢迎来到酋长球场观看这场已成为巴克莱女子英超关键对决的比赛——对阵曼联。当比赛在我们的主场灯光下进行时，我们更加喜爱。球员和工作人员们都迫不及待地想要回到草坪上展现我们的实力。
周日比赛后出现了很多失望和沮丧的情绪，我们在本周一直在努力调整。无论我们踢得有多好——从对阵水晶宫的表现中可以汲取很多积极因素——但赛季结束时结果才是一切。
我们在进攻端展现了多样性，无论是定位球还是运动战，但最后一下的终结有所欠缺。这并不是因为缺乏努力或强度。过去有时在进球迟迟不来时会出现恐慌，但我认为上周末并非如此。我们从未停止相信自己能进球。从心态角度来看，这正是我们需要保持的。但我们必须更加专注于细节以求改进。
即使你带着掌控球权的期望进入比赛，打破对手的密集防守也绝非易事，特别是面对像水晶宫这样纪律严明的球队时。终场哨响后，我们不得不问自己：我们在每个机会上都步调一致了吗？每次传球、射门和跑位都达到了我们对自己要求的标准吗？
正如我们在上周末和上个赛季所发现的，平局阻碍了我们实现应有的潜力。我们已经有太多做得很好的地方，也有太多我能看到的进步之处，所以我们不能在上周末纠结太久。我们必须坚持并从中学习。

这周我从姑娘们身上看到的反应正是我们所期望的。在进攻三区表现果断，到目前为止的所有训练课都充满动力和活力。我们一起复盘了对阵水晶宫比赛的方方面面，随后她们在球场上付出了艰苦的努力。对我来说，没有什么比对阵曼联更好的机会来将这些收获付诸实践了，上赛季我们面对他们时未能取得进球。当然，他们本赛季换了新主教练，战术布置与以往不同，因此这对我们来说是一个需要应对的新挑战。但自然这也是我们所期待的挑战。我们一直在讨论在赛季初建立良好的势头，今晚是一个确保结果与我们的表现相匹配的机会，并且在我们即将迎来一段繁忙且重要的赛程时继续积累势头。
对于上周日未能为所有到场营造不可思议氛围的球迷们赢得一场胜利，我们都感到非常遗憾，今晚我们更加渴望奉献一场配得上你们支持的表现。感谢你们上周末从头到尾带来的能量。我们希望你们今天能带来同样的能量，因为你们的能量和信任驱使我们不断前行。
让我们共同度过一个特殊的夜晚——COYG！

items.titleEn: Premier League news: Carrick brushes aside questions over future, Arteta salutes ‘extraordinary’ Dowman
items.summaryEn: United head coach believes it will take ‘a lot longer than one or two’ setbacks before he is concerned about his job Continue reading...
bodyEn: Michael Carrick said it would take more than one or two defeats before he came under internal pressure as the Manchester United head coach.

United lost 3-2 to Brighton in the Carabao Cup on Wednesday, having led 2-0 at Old Trafford. That followed Sunday’s 1-0 home loss to 10-man Manchester City. United also went down 2-0 at Hull on the opening day of the season and conceded a late equaliser at Everton at the beginning of the month. The results have caused Carrick to come under scrutiny and he was reminded before Sunday’s visit to Fulham that his predecessors, Erik ten Hag and Ruben Amorim, were sacked after 30 months and 14 months, respectively, in the job.

“It will be a lot longer than one or two games of results,” Carrick said when asked when he might come under pressure from United’s hierarchy. “It’s irrelevant for me. I know the club, I know the role, I know what’s expected here in terms of playing at a certain standard.

“In terms of the future and ownership and how long I’ve got, it’s totally nothing, it’s ridiculous to think that way in the position I’m in; it’s just not on the radar. It’s two or three games we haven’t had certain results. We’ve got to perform and we’ve got a lot of games to plan for.”

Carrick is content to take ownership of his team’s performance. “That’s why I’m here. It’s my responsibility, I’m fine with that,” he said. “It’s not a blame game. We always search for things to look at and find the blame, sometimes it gets too much. Blame me, it’s no problem, but it’s not about blaming people. It’s about finding solutions. It’s a collective thing. I know where we want to go and we want to get there fast. We don’t like losing matches, but it doesn’t affect what we do next.”
The 45-year-old was asked if he needs to show more emotion on the touchline. “I need to show more emotion? In what way?” he replied. “What do you want me to show?”

On Friday JJ Gabriel travelled to Barcelona for discussions regarding potentially joining the club, with United understood to have found out via the media despite the 15-year-old being registered with them.

On Tuesday Gabriel told United he wanted his registration rescinded because he wishes to join another club. Real Madrid have a firm interest and it is understood Gabriel and his advisers travelled for preliminary talks with Barcelona.
Carrick said: “The situation will work itself out, whatever way it’s going to work itself out. Making sure he’s OK is the important thing.” Jamie Jackson
Mikel Arteta has praised Max Dowman’s “extraordinary” transition from schoolboy to Arsenal first-team squad member and backed the teenager to make more of an impact this season.

Dowman became the first 16-year-old since Wayne Rooney in October 2002 to score twice for a Premier League club in Arsenal’s victory over Ipswich in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday, after bursting on to the scene last year. That was his first appearance of the campaign, having been an unused substitute on four occasions as Arsenal have won all seven of their fixtures. Dowman, who has been training with Arsenal’s first team since he was 14, completed his GCSEs in the summer and he will study for a BTec qualification after deciding against taking A-Levels. Arteta said Dowman’s development was still being carefully managed by Arsenal after a couple of years of having to balance his studies.

“It’s not easy,” said the Arsenal manager. “That’s what tells you about the craziness of the age and the environment he still lives in with the demands and the competition he needs to face during the week. But the way he has handled it, him and the family, it has been extraordinary. If he is here, he has to be here in all conditions and we cannot treat him differently in many aspects.”

Dowman is in contention to be on the bench to face Brighton on Saturday as Arsenal attempt to make it eight successive victories to start the season for the first time since their promotion season as Woolwich Arsenal in 1903-04. Arteta is convinced more opportunities will come his way sooner rather than later. “That’s the best way to knock on the door: to do it on the pitch, not in the office,” he said. “What Max did the other day, alongside all the players as well, that haven’t played that many minutes, it was really impressive.”

Premier League regulations do not allow players under 17 to be sent out on loan but Luton are understood to have registered an interest in Dowman, who was coached by their manager, Jack Wilshere, when he played for Arsenal’s under-18s. Arteta said it was possible Dowman could be allowed to leave in January, by which point he will be 17, but that his immediate future was at Arsenal.

“We haven’t really listened to any of the possibilities because we were crystal clear that we wanted to have him in the squad, that we wanted him to be part of the pre-season and then start to see where we are from there,” Arteta said.

“We will evaluate every six months, where we are and what is the best thing for him to do and then make the right decision. It depends on a lot of factors – what he needs and what the team needs as well, the availability we have in the squad, the minutes that he is playing and the qualities of those minutes. We have to be open but now the focus is to be here and to impact the team.” Ed Aarons

Roberto De Zerbi has insisted Sandro Tonali was not feeling the pressure of his price tag despite a mixed start to life at Tottenham. The midfielder became the most expensive player in the club’s history when he joined from Newcastle for £92.5m in the summer.

De Zerbi made a big play to sign Tonali amid interest from Manchester City and Arsenal, delivering a two-hour sales pitch to his fellow Italian to convince him to move to north London. He outlined how central Tonali would be to his plans and explained what he could expect from Spurs’ fans and the team’s style of football.

Tonali has started all four Premier League games this season – in which Spurs have drawn twice and lost twice without scoring – but has produced underwhelming defensive numbers and created only three chances.

De Zerbi revealed he had spoken to the 26-year-old about the weight of the price tag and claimed the player “doesn’t feel the pressure about that”. The Spurs manager pointed out that Tonali took time to adapt in his first season at Milan in 2020 before becoming one of the most sought-after young midfielders in the world once he settled there.

De Zerbi said “the adaptation has been not so fast” at Tottenham “but it can happen”, adding: “It is not so easy to change city, to change everything, for the players. Sometimes the adaptation is immediate, sometimes you need more time.”

Tottenham’s struggles in front of goal have not been helped by Tonali’s inability to create chances for the forwards. The goalless draw against Everton was the first in 140 games at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and followed a 0-0 at Nottingham Forest, thereby equalling Spurs’ tally of goalless games in the previous 181 matches. The last time they recorded three or more consecutive goalless draws in the league was 25 years ago under George Graham, when they went to four.

It is a remarkable run, especially after a summer spend of more than £300m, which leaves Spurs in 17th going into Saturday’s game against Aston Villa, who have also struggled after a summer of major change.

De Zerbi maintained he was happy with Tonali’s performances – even though he believed they could improve – and described him as “a complete midfielder”. “His physical characteristics are to play box-to-box but he started his career as a playmaker. He’s good enough with the ball, he’s good enough without the ball.” Sam Cunningham

Daniel Farke said Dominic Calvert-Lewin was “like a good wine” after the in-form striker’s call-up into Thomas Tuchel’s England squad. The 29-year-old has been included in the Three Lions’ squad for their Nations League matches after scoring four goals in six appearances in all competitions this season.

Calvert-Lewin was given a standing ovation by Leeds fans as he was withdrawn late on in Monday night’s 4-1 win against Newcastle at Elland Road. “Dominic is like a good wine, getting better by the year,” Farke said. “Physically, he’s on a top level and his pace is more than good enough I would say. He’s a very complete striker.”

He arrived at Leeds on a free transfer from Everton in August last year and when asked where he ranked among his best signings, Farke said: “At Leeds, while I’ve been here, we’ve made many top signings on a low budget.

“When I think about Joe Rodon, Ethan Ampadu, Ao Tanaka … It’s difficult to compare because as a striker you have a different role. But he’s definitely one of our better pieces of business. If you come as a free agent it doesn’t mean it costs no money because there’s a salary. But we believed in him when perhaps not many were doing this. He also believes in himself and he believes in Leeds United, so I would say he was a perfect fit.” Press Association

items.titleZh: 英超新闻：卡里克淡化对未来的疑问，阿尔特塔赞赏道曼“非凡”的发挥
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔对小将道曼从学生到一线队的非凡过渡表示赞赏，并支持其本赛季产生更大影响。
bodyZh: 迈克尔·卡里克表示，作为曼联主帅，他需要经历多场失利才会受到内部压力。
在老特拉福德以2比0领先的情况下，曼联周三在联赛杯中以2比3输给布莱顿。此前，他们在周日主场0比1不敌少打一人的曼城。曼联还在赛季开局客场0比2不敌赫尔城，并在本月初对阵埃弗顿的比赛中被对手在尾声阶段绝平。这些结果让卡里克受到了严格审视，在周日客场对阵富勒姆之前，人们提醒他，他的前任埃里克·滕哈赫和鲁本·阿莫林分别在任职30个月和14个月后被解雇。
当被问及何时可能面临来自曼联高层的压力时，卡里克表示：“这需要比一两场比赛的结果长得多。这对我来说并不重要。我了解这家俱乐部，了解这个角色，也知道这里对达到一定水准的要求。”
“至于未来、所有权以及我还有多长时间，这完全不存在，在我目前的位置上有这种想法是荒谬的；这根本不在考虑范围内。这是两三场比赛我们没有取得某些结果。我们必须拿出表现，我们有很多比赛要规划。”
卡里克愿意为球队的表现承担责任。“这就是我在这里的原因。这是我的责任，我对此没有异议，”他说。“这不是一场互相指责的游戏。我们总是在寻找事情来审视并寻找责任所在，有时这太过分了。责怪我吧，没问题，但这与责怪别人无关。这是关于寻找解决方案。这是一个集体的事。我知道我们想去哪里，我们想快点到那里。我们不喜欢输球，但这不会影响我们接下来要做什么。”
这位45岁的教练被问及他是否需要在场边表现出更多情绪。“我需要表现出更多情绪？以什么方式？”他回答说，“你想让我表现出什么？”
周五，JJ·加布里埃尔前往巴塞罗那，就潜在加盟该俱乐部进行商谈，据了解曼联是通过媒体才得知这一消息的，尽管这名15岁的球员已在他们那里注册。
周二，加布里埃尔告诉曼联，他希望注销注册，因为他希望加盟另一家俱乐部。皇家马德里表现出浓厚兴趣，据了解加布里埃尔及其顾问已前往巴塞罗那进行初步会谈。
卡里克说：“这种情况会自行解决，无论它将以何种方式解决。确保他一切正常是最重要的事情。” 杰米·杰克逊
米克尔·阿尔特塔称赞了马克斯·道曼从学生到阿森纳一线队成员的“非凡”过渡，并支持这名青少年本赛季产生更大影响。

在周二阿森纳在联赛杯击败伊普斯维奇的比赛中，道曼自去年崭露头角以来梅开二度，成为自2002年10月韦恩·鲁尼以来首位为英超俱乐部单场打进两球的16岁球员。这是他本赛季的首次出场，在此前阿森纳取得七连胜的比赛中，他曾四次未出场替补。道曼自14岁起就一直在阿森纳一线队随队训练，他在夏天完成了GCSE考试，在决定不参加A-Level考试后，他将攻读BTEC资格证书。阿尔特塔表示，在平衡了几年学业后，阿森纳仍在精心管理道曼的发展。
“这并不容易，”阿森纳主教练说。“这就是告诉你他所处的年龄有多疯狂，以及他在一周内需要面对的需求和竞争的生活环境。但他处理这一切的方式，包括他本人和他的家人，都是非凡的。如果他来到这里，他必须在所有条件下都在这里，我们不能在许多方面区别对待他。”
道曼有望进入周六对阵布莱顿的替补席，阿森纳正试图自1903-04赛季以伍尔维奇阿森纳身份升级以来，首次在赛季开局取得八连胜。阿尔特塔坚信，更多机会会早晚到来。“敲门的最好方式是在球场上做到，而不是在办公室里，”他说。“马克斯前几天和其他没有踢那么多时间的球员一起做的事情，真的让人印象深刻。”
英超联赛规定不允许17岁以下的球员外租，但据了解卢顿对道曼表现出了兴趣，道曼在效力阿森纳U18时曾接受过他们现任主教练杰克·威尔希尔的指导。阿尔特塔表示，道曼可能会在一月份被允许离开，届时他将年满17岁，但他目前的未来仍在阿森纳。
阿尔特塔说：“我们没有真正听取任何可能性，因为我们非常清楚，我们希望将他留在阵容中，我们希望他成为季前赛的一部分，然后从那里开始看看我们的处境。”
“我们将每六个月评估一次，我们身处何地，对他来说最好的事情是什么，然后做出正确的决定。这取决于很多因素——他需要什么，球队也需要什么，我们在阵容中拥有的人员可用性，他正在踢的分钟数以及这些分钟的质量。我们必须保持开放，但现在的重点是留在这里并对球队产生影响。” 爱德华·阿隆斯
罗伯托·德泽尔比坚称，尽管在托特纳姆热刺的开局表现喜忧参半，但桑德罗·托纳利并没有感受到身价带来的压力。这位中场球员在夏天以9250万英镑从纽卡斯尔加盟时，成为了俱乐部历史上身价最高的球员。
在曼城和阿森纳的兴趣中，德泽尔比为签下托纳利做出了巨大努力，向这位同胞发表了两个小时的推销演讲，说服他搬到北伦敦。他概述了托纳利在他的计划中将处于多么核心的地位，并解释了他可以从热刺球迷和球队足球风格中期待什么。
托纳利本赛季首发出战了全部四场英超联赛——热刺取得了两平两负且一球未进的战绩——但他的防守数据表现平平，仅创造了三次机会。
德泽尔比透露，他曾与这位26岁的球员谈过身价的重量，并声称这名球员“对此没有感到压力”。热刺主帅指出，托纳利在2020年加盟米兰的第一个赛季也花了一段时间适应，一旦在那里安顿下来，他就成为了世界上最受追捧的年轻中场之一。
德泽尔比表示，托纳利在热刺“适应得不是很快”，“但这是会发生的”，并补充道：“对于球员来说，换城市、改变一切并不是那么容易。有时适应是即时的，有时你需要更多时间。”
由于托纳利无法为前锋创造机会，热刺在门前的挣扎并未得到缓解。主场对阵埃弗顿的互交白卷是托特纳姆热刺球场140场比赛中的第一场，此前他们还在客场0比0战平诺丁汉森林，这追平了热刺在过去181场比赛中的零进球场次纪录。他们上一次在联赛中连续三场或更多场比赛互交白卷还要追溯到25岁前的乔治·格雷厄姆执教时期，当时他们连续四场没有进球。
这是一段引人注目的连胜，尤其是在夏天花费超过3亿英镑之后，这使得热刺在周六对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛前排在第17位，维拉在经历了夏季的大变动后同样表现挣扎。
德泽尔比坚称他对托纳利表现感到满意——尽管他相信他们可以做得更好——并将其描述为“一名全能中场”。“他的身体特点是踢B2B（全能中场），但他以组织核心开始职业生涯。他在有球时足够好，在无球时也足够好。”萨姆·坎宁安
丹尼尔·法尔克在状态正佳的前锋多米尼克·卡尔沃特-勒温入选托马斯·图赫尔的英格兰代表队后，称赞他“就像一瓶好酒”。这位29岁的球员在本赛季各项赛事出场6次打进4球后，入选了三狮军团的欧国联大名单。
在周一晚埃兰路球场4比1战胜纽卡斯尔的比赛尾声被换下时，卡尔沃特-勒温受到了利兹联球迷起立鼓掌的礼遇。“多米尼克就像一瓶好酒，随着年岁增长而变得更好，”法尔克说。“在身体上，他处于顶级水平，我要说他的速度也足够好。他是一个非常全面的前锋。”
他在去年8月以自由转会的方式从埃弗顿加盟利兹联，当被问及他在自己最好的引援中排在什么位置时，法尔克说：“在利兹联，自我来到这里以来，我们在低预算下完成了许多顶级引援。”
“当我想到乔·罗登、伊桑·阿帕杜、田中碧……这很难比较，因为作为前锋，你扮演着不同的角色。但他绝对是我们最好的几笔交易之一。如果你以自由球员身份加盟，并不意味着不花钱，因为还有薪水。但当或许没有多少人这样做时，我们信任了他。他也相信自己，相信利兹联，所以我想说他是完美契合。”新闻协会

items.titleEn: Date confirmed for Carabao Cup trip to Fleetwood
items.summaryEn: We will face the League Two side in the next round of the competition
bodyEn: We have been drawn against Fleetwood Town in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup, with the tie to take place at the League Two side's Highbury Stadium on Tuesday, October 27.
The game will kick off at 8pm and be broadcast in the UK on Sky Sports.
After beating Ipswich Town 4-2 at Portman Road on Tuesday to advance in the competition, we will now face the Fishermen in what will be the first-ever competitive meeting between the sides.

Fleetwood reached this stage by beating fellow fourth-tier opposition Chesterfield and Shrewsbury Town, before then knocking out Championship side Sheffield United in the third round. All of their ties have been held at their 5,300-capacity home in the north-west.

We reached the final last season before Manchester City pipped us to the silverware at Wembley, missing out on having our name engraved on the trophy for a third time, with our two successes coming in 1987 and 1993.
Ticket information will be announced in due course.

items.titleEn: Preview: Brighton v Arsenal
items.summaryEn: Our essential matchday guide is packed with team news, stats, history, tactics, TV coverage and more ahead of our game against Brighton at the Amex Stadium
bodyEn: We are looking to win 10 Premier League games in a row for the first time in 24 years when we head to the south coast to face Brighton & Hove Albion on Saturday (3pm UK).

2026/27 has gone perfectly so far, with seven victories out of seven across all competitions, and another at the Amex Stadium would level our club record for consecutive wins at the start of a season, set back in 1903.

Having previously been a bogey ground for us we haven't lost at the Seagulls' home since 2020, although Fabian Hurzeler's team have made it a formidable place to go recently, banging in goals galore to fire them to an impressive start on both the domestic and continental stages.
FREE-SCORING SEAGULLS

After finishing eighth last term, Brighton secured a 10th successive season at this level as well as European football for just the second time in their history, and clinched a spot in the Europa Conference League league stage by beating Norwegian side Tromso 4-0 on aggregate in a play-off last month.

Despite an ever-growing injury list, Fabian Hurzeler’s Seagulls continue to fly in the top-flight, and head into this weekend in fifth spot. The Seagulls are the division’s top scorers with nine of their 13 goals coming across their two wins so far - a 4-0 win against Aston Villa on the opening day, and last weekend’s 5-0 demolition of Coventry City. More followed in a 4-3 loss at Chelsea, while they drew 1-1 with Leeds United in their last Amex encounter.

Their fixtures have seen 28 goals spread across seven matches in all competitions, with more entertainment coming in midweek when they became the first team to beat Manchester United at Old Trafford when trailing at half-time since May 1984, recovering from 2-0 down to secure a spot in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup.
WHAT THE MANAGERS SAY

Arteta: "[Four successive away games] is one of the challenges of the schedule, and the team has responded so well by playing with dominance. It doesn't really matter if we play at home or away, we want to be the same team and we want to cause the same kind of problems to the opposition.

"We have managed to win the three games, and we've got the last one against a really tough opponent, and we'll try to do the same. I have huge respect for Fabian; what he’s done and what Brighton have done as a club, it’s just remarkable. Tomorrow is going to be a beautiful game to watch."

Hurzeler: "I believe the basic things brought us here; the hard work, the non-negotiables, the small margins. Everyone knows their role and everyone knows that we can only compete with the best if we all do everything at the highest level. That's the message that we try to reinforce.

"It is a new season now - [Arsenal] have started very impressively and they are maybe the best team in England - so it is our challenge to compete with them by focusing on the game and playing our style of play. I do believe we have a chance to win this game."
TEAM NEWS

Ben White is expected to be OK to face his former club despite coming off against Sunderland at half-time, while Cristhian Mosquera and Piero Hincapie are also back in training as they aim to bolster Mikel Arteta's defensive options.
One stopper who is out, though, is William Saliba, who continues his recovery from a back problem.

Hurzeler has seen his squad decimated by injuries in the early weeks, including new recruits Femi Azeez and Michael Svoboda, who have yet to appear since their moves from Millwall and Venezia, respectively, while another new boy, Zadok Yohanna, has missed the last four league games.

Fellow winger Yankuba Minteh required surgery for a leg injury sustained in pre-season and is out until November, while Mats Wieffer and Stefanos Tzimas have knee problems. Jack Hinshelwood and Evan Ferguson have ankle injuries, while Kaoru Mitoma remains out with the hamstring injury that saw him sit out the World Cup. Hurzeler will be relieved that Luka Vuskovic and Jaouen Hadjam should be fine after picking up knocks at Old Trafford on Wednesday.
TALKING TACTICS

Adrian Clarke: Hurzeler’s team will present arguably our stiffest challenge so far this season. They move the ball around fluently, score goals freely and are a side designed to disrupt the flow of their opponents. They are the best pressing side in the division right now, registering 41 high turnovers, and Hurzeler loves his team to play aggressively, so our players must strap themselves in for a high-tempo, physical battle.

Facing an opponent who plays this way might suit us. We are certainly playing well enough to pass through Brighton’s press, and if we manage that, we can expose a defence that is still bedding in as a unit. Brighton conceded four times at Chelsea, and in most matches, keeper Bart Verbruggen has been kept busy, preventing an extra 1.4 goals being scored in 2026/27.

Averaging almost 71% possession across four league fixtures, they like to dictate, so this may not be a contest we control matters inside the opposition half. Hassling their midfield unit of Pascal Gross and Yasin Ayari will be key to disrupting their flow. Again, this type of game may help, rather than hinder us, as no Premier League side has produced more direct attacks (11) than us.

Veteran midfielder Gross is in sparkling form, so he is the danger man. In open play, he is level with Martin Odegaard for the most chances created (11) in this campaign. Left winger Maxim de Cuyper is another player we must keep close tabs on as the Belgian has been bright and imaginative during the early weeks, directly contributing to four goals in all competitions.
FACTS AND STATS
We are unbeaten in six Premier League games against Brighton (W4 D2), since a 3-0 defeat at Emirates Stadium in May 2023.
Brighton have only lost one of their last six Premier League home games, winning four and scoring 2+ goals in all of those.

We are looking to win five consecutive Premier League away games for the third time under Mikel Arteta (in 127 matches). We achieved this just twice in our previous 290 away league matches before his tenure.

Bukayo Saka has been involved in five goals in six Premier League away games against Brighton (3 goals, 2 assists), scoring on each of his last three visits to the Amex Stadium. The only Arsenal players to score in 4+ straight away appearances against an opponent in the competition are Thierry Henry at Middlesbrough (4 between 2000 and 2003) and Robert Pires at Tottenham Hotspur (5 between 2001 and 2005).
Kai Havertz has been involved in five goals (4 goals, 1 assist) in eight Premier League matches against Brighton, against no other side does he have more goal involvements.
Odegaard has scored three Premier League goals against Brighton, only against Wolves (4) has he netted more in the competition.
MATCH OFFICIALS

Darren England has been appointed to this fixture, and he remains a good luck charm for us. We have won seven out of nine under his watch, including all three last term when we beat Nottingham Forest, Aston Villa and Chelsea at home. He hasn’t awarded us a penalty or sent one of our players off in those nine matches.

However, he also seems to be a positive omen for the Seagulls, as they have only lost two of the 13 he’s controlled, with 11 of those taking place at at the Amex. He was also in the middle for home wins against Manchester City and Liverpool last term.
Referee: Darren EnglandAssistants: Scott Ledger, Alistair NelsonFourth official: Michael SalisburyVAR: Tim WoodAssistant VAR: James Mainwaring
RECENT TRIPS TO THE AMEX

After losing two of our first three Premier League trips to the Amex Stadium, we haven’t tasted defeat in any of our last six visits, with our most recent trip in March settled by a ninth-minute Bukayo Saka strike, as we clung on to claim three precious points that would ultimately take us to the title.

The previous trip in January 2025 yielded only a point as we took the lead through Ethan Nwaneri, only for a controversial penalty to be awarded which Joao Pedro netted. Back in April 2024, we recorded an emphatic 3-0 win thanks to a Saka penalty plus strikes from Kai Havertz and ex-Seagull Leandro Trossard.
LIVE COVERAGE

Live commentary will be available on Arsenal.com and The Arsenal app (download now on iOS/Android) from just before kick-off, with Dan Roebuck and Adrian Clarke behind the mics to guide you through all the on-field action.
You can also find out which broadcasters are showing the action live, wherever you are in the world.

items.titleZh: 赛事前瞻：布莱顿对阵阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳客场挑战布莱顿，力争英超十连胜与延续纪录。
bodyZh: 本周六（英国时间下午3点），当我们前往南海岸对阵布莱顿及霍夫阿尔比恩时，我们正力争在24年来首次取得英超10连胜。
2026/27赛季至今一切完美，我们在各项赛事中取得了七战全胜的战绩。如果在运通球场再胜一场，将追平我们在1903年创下的队史赛季开局连胜纪录。
这里曾是我们的难缠客场，自2020年以来我们未曾在海鸥军团的主场输球。尽管如此，法比安·赫尔泽拉的球队近期已将这里打造成一个难以征服的主场，凭借源源不断的进球，他们在国内和欧战赛场都迎来了令人印象深刻的开局。
火力全开的海鸥军团
在上赛季获得第八名之后，布莱顿确保了他们连续第10个赛季征战顶级联赛，并且历史上第二次获得欧战资格。上个月，他们在附加赛中以4-0的总比分击败挪威球队特罗姆瑟，锁定了欧协联联赛阶段的席位。
尽管伤病名单不断拉长，法比安·赫尔泽拉的海鸥军团在顶级联赛中依然表现出色，本周末开赛前排名第五。海鸥军团是联赛中进球最多的球队，他们的13个进球中有9个来自此前的两场胜利——首轮4-0大胜阿斯顿维拉，以及上周末5-0大胜考文垂城。随后他们在客场3-4不敌切尔西，并在上一场运通球场的比赛中1-1战平利兹联。
在各项赛事的七场比赛中，他们的场次共产生了28粒进球。周中他们更是在老特拉福德完成逆转，成为自1984年5月以来首支在半场落后的情况下击败曼联的球队，从0-2落后的局面中奋起直追，锁定了一个联赛杯第四轮的席位。
主教练言论
阿尔特塔：“[连续四个客场]是赛程带来的挑战之一，球队以统治级的表现做出了非常出色的回应。无论我们在主场还是客场作战，这其实并不重要，我们希望成为同一支球队，并给对手制造同等程度的麻烦。”
“我们成功赢下了前三场比赛，现在将迎来对阵一个极其强硬对手的最后一场比赛，我们将尝试做到同样的事情。我对法比安充满敬意；他所做的一切以及布莱顿作为一家俱乐部所取得的成就，简直非凡。明天将会是一场赏心悦目的比赛。”
赫尔泽拉：“我相信是基础的东西把我们带到了这里；努力工作、不可妥协的精神以及微小的优势。每个人都知道自己的角色，每个人都知道只有当我们在最高水平上做好所有事情时，我们才能与最强者竞争。这就是我们试图强化的信息。”
“现在是一个新赛季——[阿森纳]开局非常惊艳，他们或许是英格兰最好的球队——因此我们的挑战是通过专注于比赛并踢出我们自己的风格来与他们竞争。我坚信我们有机会赢得这场比赛。”
球队新闻
本·怀特在对阵桑德兰的比赛中半场被换下，但预计能够出场对阵他的老东家。同时，克里斯蒂安·莫斯克拉和皮耶罗·因卡皮耶也已恢复训练，旨在增强米克尔·阿尔特塔的后防选择。
不过缺阵的后卫是威廉·萨利巴，他仍在继续从背部伤势中恢复。
赫尔泽拉的阵容在赛季初期遭遇了严重的伤病潮，包括新援费米·阿泽兹和迈克尔·斯沃博达，他们自分别从米尔沃尔和威尼斯加盟以来尚未出场；另一位新员扎多克·约哈纳也错过了过去四场联赛。
同为边锋的扬库巴·明特因季前赛中遭受的腿部伤势接受了手术，将缺阵至11月；马茨·魏费尔和斯特凡诺斯·齐马斯则有膝盖问题。杰克·欣谢尔伍德和埃文·费尔森遭遇脚踝伤势，三笘薰则继续因导致他缺席世界杯的腿筋伤势高挂免战牌。周三在老特拉福德受到轻伤的卢卡·武斯科维奇和贾乌安·哈贾姆应该没有大碍，这会让赫尔泽拉松一口气。
战术探讨
阿德里安·克拉克：赫尔泽拉的球队可以说是我们本赛季迄今为止面临的最严峻挑战。他们传球流畅，进球轻松，是一支旨在打乱对手进攻节奏的球队。他们是目前联赛中最好的高位逼抢球队，拥有41次高位抢断，赫尔泽拉喜欢让球队进行极具侵略性的踢法，因此我们的球员必须做好迎接快节奏、身体对抗激烈的比赛准备。
面对这样踢法的对手可能正合我们心意。我们目前的竞技状态完全有能力通过布莱顿的逼抢，如果我们能做到这一点，我们就能暴露他们那支仍在磨合中的防线。布莱顿在切尔西身上丢了四球，而且在大多数比赛中，门将巴特·韦尔布吕根都十分忙碌，在2026/27赛季中已经多阻止了1.4个失球。
他们在四场联赛中平均控球率接近71%，喜欢主导比赛，因此这可能不是一场我们在对方半场完全掌控局面的比赛。纠缠他们的中场组合帕斯卡尔·格罗斯和亚辛·阿亚里将是打乱他们节奏的关键。同样，这种类型的比赛可能会对我们有利而非阻碍，因为没有哪支英超球队比我们制造了更多的直接进攻（11次）。
老将中场格罗斯状态正佳，因此他是危险人物。在运动战中，他在本赛季创造机会次数（11次）上与马丁·厄德高并列。左边锋马克西姆·德屈佩尔是我们必须密切关注的另一名球员，这位比利时人在赛季初期表现亮眼且富有想象力，在各项赛事中直接参与了四粒进球。
事实与数据
我们在英超对阵布莱顿的6场比赛中保持不败（4胜2平），自2023年5月在酋长球场0-3失利以来未尝败绩。
布莱顿在最近六个英超主场比赛中只输了一场，赢了四场，并且在所有这些比赛中都打入了2球以上。
在米克尔·阿尔特塔的带领下（127场比赛中），我们正寻求第三次取得英超客场五连胜。在他执教之前的290场联赛客场比赛中，我们仅达成过两次这一成就。
布卡约·萨卡在客场对阵布莱顿的6场英超比赛中参与了5粒进球（3球，2次助攻），并且在他最近三次造访运通球场时均有进球。在英超联赛中，唯一能在连续4场以上客场对阵同一对手时都有进球的阿森纳球员是蒂埃里·亨利（2000年至2003年对阵米德尔斯堡连续4场）和罗伯特·皮雷（2001年至2005年对阵托特纳姆热刺连续5场）。
凯·哈弗茨在对阵布莱顿的8场英超比赛中参与了5粒进球（4球，1次助攻），没有哪支球队能让他参与更多进球。
厄德高在英超中对阵布莱顿打入三球，在联赛中只有对阵狼队（4球）时他的进球更多。
比赛官员
达伦·英格兰已被任命执法本场比赛，他堪称我们的幸运星。在他执法下我们取得了九战七胜的战绩，其中包括上赛季我们在主场击败诺丁汉森林、阿斯顿维拉和切尔西的三场胜利。在这九场比赛中，他没有判给我们点球，也没有罚下过我们的球员。
然而，他似乎也是海鸥军团的吉祥物，因为在他控制的13场比赛中，他们只输了两场，其中11场是在运通球场进行的。上赛季主场击败曼城和利物浦的比赛也是由他主裁。
裁判：达伦·英格兰，助理裁判：斯科特·莱杰、阿拉斯代尔·尼尔森，第四官员：迈克尔·索尔兹伯里，VAR：蒂姆·伍德，助理VAR：詹姆斯·曼温宁
近期造访运通球场纪录
在客场对阵运通球场的前三场英超比赛中输掉两场后，我们在最近六次造访中未尝败绩。我们最近一次在3月份的造访凭借布卡约·萨卡在第9分钟的进球锁定胜局，当时我们艰难保住三分，这最终帮助我们走向了冠军。
2025年1月的上一次造访只带走了一分，当时我们凭借伊森·恩瓦内里的进球取得领先，随后却送出了一记有争议的点球，由若昂·佩德罗罚进。而在2024年4月，凭借萨卡的点球以及哈弗茨和前海鸥球员莱安德罗·特罗萨德的进球，我们取得了3-0的大胜。

bodyEn: The poet Jorge Luis Borges wrote a famous short story about a society that had become so good at making maps, so obsessed with capturing every detail, that its rulers decided the only way to do the job right was to make a lifesize map of its entire empire, which could then be laid out across the actual land from coast to coast. Imagine a map of Britain the exact same size as Britain, showing every branch of Greggs, every nail bar, every vape shop in perfect detail. Only then can we really see what Britain looks like, by standing on a fake Britain laid over the top of actual Britain.

Borges was writing in the 1940s, at a time when people were fascinated by the mechanised future, with its new forms of measuring out the world: the wireless, the 30mph motorcar, the rise of Big Tape Measure. And to be fair, the mega-map is a pretty accurate vision of our own fully networked present, a place where you can snoop around a village in Mozambique from your laptop in Egham, where no one ever stops committing acts of minute self-surveillance, even if they think they’re just searching “What is beetroot?” on the internet.

Borges also hated football. “Soccer is popular because stupidity is popular,” he wrote, which probably seemed a bold statement at the time. But then Borges also didn’t live to see an episode of Wow Sports Premier League Breakfast at Breakfast with Roger McRoger and a puzzled Lee Trundle. After which, perhaps less of a surprise. But the process he describes is also a good description of what football is doing to itself. Endless data, endless analysis, no spaces or free air, matches that are just schematised movement. At times it can feel like football is out there laying a lifesize real-time map on top of itself.

In Borges’s story, the land soon begins to decay beneath the massive map – which is reassessed by later generations as insane, pointless and stupid – and left to rot in the desert. We haven’t reached this point. Nobody is de-mapping football. But it does perhaps explain why everyone gets so excited when a talent emerges that seems to be playful and human, to exist outside the grid. And also why it has felt wrong to gush too soon about Max Dowman, to fear placing the hex on him. We know how this works. Here is a fluffy new thing. Let us break him. Let us heap pressure on his shoulders. Don’t talk about Max Dowman. Let Max Dowman exist, breathe, bloom in the shadows.

So, Max Dowman then. It has become quite hard to ignore him. He was brilliant against Ipswich in midweek, and brilliant in a way that seems solid and real and comfortable with itself. Most obviously there were the two goals, both a perfect snapshot of why Dowman seems equipped to survive, more state‑of‑the‑art than some other young players we’ve burdened with expectation.

The second goal is particularly good, five perfect little actions packed into six seconds of football. Arsenal have the ball on the edge of the Ipswich box. Dowman shows for a pass, sees it’s going elsewhere, changes his mind, and makes a three-yard sprint to create space. Finally he has the physical capacity to control a bouncing ball in that sliver of space, to move his feet so much quicker than the nearest defender it looks like a glitch in the machine, and to finish in a way that involves sifting the options and timing the shot, all without breaking stride.

The first goal is on his other side, and involves a more classical piece of one-on-one deception. This is the same defender: Cédric Kipré, 29 years old, came through Paris Saint-Germain’s youth system. Dowman walks through him with a micro-feint and a switch of feet, then reels off another hilariously understated finish, doing it all while a second defender is still gathering himself to lunge, like a man operating in a different time signature to everyone around him.

This is the key point of difference, the ability to make everything stop, the fly-vision that means he sees what’s about to happen while everyone else is whirling about trying to read the charts, in the same way Lionel Messi (yes, sorry, sorry) always seems to have time to pass the ball into the net, like this is all a kickabout in a pair of sliders.

Our way of understanding young creative players has often seemed to lag behind where the game actually is, to be driven by nostalgia for what this thing used to look like. I remember the excitement over the 18-year-old Jack Rodwell’s physicality at the exact moment physicality was no longer going to be a thing, like proudly unveiling the latest horse‑drawn train just as the Ford Model T rolls off the production line.

Michael Owen was brilliant at 17, but he was mainly brilliant at running very fast in a straight line and smashing the ball into the net. Plus of course there was Wayne Rooney, who emerged a pale, unformed teenager composed entirely from energy drinks and white bread, out there making the game up on the fly, as though some urban foundling had come barrelling over the advert boards with a string of sausages still dangling from his mouth.

The narrative around Rooney is that he lost this vital native quality. But Rooney adapted and survived, and clearly understood what he had to be a lot better than those of us watching. And even now creative players have to exist against this. Cole Palmer is exciting because he does surprising things that seem to be striking a blow for freedom, beauty and older people who struggle to make their email work. But his real challenge is to retain just enough of this while fitting the world around him.

Dowman is a bit different. The things that make him stand out seem to speak very easily to how football is now. Being a modern creative footballer is not jinking runs, rasping drives or dribbling across a cabbage field in a pair of cowboy boots. It’s targeted energy, high-intensity semi-freedom. Lamine Yamal and Désiré Doué have the same fast-twitch foot and brain speed, the ability to operate in micro-moments, to see patterns just ahead of time. Dowman is 6ft tall and getting stronger. He won’t be kicked to pieces. He can repeat this without taking bites out of himself.

There is still the issue of his youth. But maybe this doesn’t matter so much either. The world has changed. In the age of Rooney and Owen there was no care, no data, no softness. This is where the structures of modern football are an advantage. Dowman will be GPS’d to the last decimal point. Endless physical scientists will have a say on his output and stress levels.

The money is too big. The talent is too valuable. It also comes ready to plug and play. You don’t get to this level unless you can ingest systems and briefings. You’ve already been pressure-cooked and stress-tested. What you’re being asked to do in the orderly spaces of professional football is the same thing you were asked to do in the orderly spaces of academy football, just five levels up and with more people watching.

Borges was anti-football because he saw it as inauthentic, the players no longer sports people but “actors in jerseys before the TV cameras”. And this is also fine, further evidence that boomer-dad nostalgia is one of the key archetypes of human behaviour.

Life is also different now; not harder or easier, but more instant, a series of moments, the creation of rapid-fire energy. Dowman has grown up inside this. He can parcel his time out, disappear for a bit, maybe make a show of things in the spring.

And yes, this is another way of fitting him to a model, laying a lifesize map of future Max Dowman across the present. But I strongly suspect he will be fine, and that unlike so many other things out there he’s pretty well adapted to whatever the future is supposed to look like.

items.titleZh: 我们本想让马克斯·道曼在阴影中绽放，但他如今已让人难以忽视
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳小将马克斯·道曼表现出色，展现出适应现代足球的巨大潜力。
bodyZh: 诗人豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯曾写过一篇著名的短篇小说，讲述了一个极其擅长绘制地图、痴迷于捕捉每一个细节的社会，其统治者认为把工作做好的唯一方法就是绘制一张与整个帝国等大的地图，然后将其铺在从海岸到海岸的实际土地上。想象一下一张与英国大小完全相同的英国地图，以完美的细节显示了格雷格斯的每一家分店、每一家美甲店、每一家电子烟店。只有这样，通过站在覆盖在真实英国之上的虚假英国上，我们才能真正看到英国是什么样子的。
博尔赫斯写作于20世纪40年代，当时人们对机械化的未来及其衡量世界的新方式着迷：无线电设备、时速30英里的汽车、巨型卷尺的兴起。平心而论，超级地图确实是我们现在这个完全联网的时代的精准愿景，在这里你可以通过英厄姆的笔记本电脑窥探莫桑比克的一个村庄，在这里没有人会停止进行微观的自我监视，即使他们认为自己只是在互联网上搜索“什么是甜菜根”。

博尔赫斯也讨厌足球。“足球受欢迎是因为愚蠢受欢迎，”他写道，这在当时可能是一个很大胆的说法。但博尔赫斯也没有活到看到罗杰·麦克罗杰和困惑的李·特伦德主持的《疯狂体育英超早餐》节目的那一刻。在那之后，也许就不会那么令人惊讶了。但他所描述的过程也是足球对其自身所做事情的生动写照。无休止的数据、无休止的分析、没有空间或自由空气、比赛只是图解式的运动。有时人们会觉得足球正在把一张与现实等时的地图铺在自己身上。

在博尔赫斯的故事中，巨大的地图之下的土地很快就开始腐烂——后来几代人重新评估其为疯狂、毫无意义和愚蠢——并任其在沙漠中腐烂。我们还没有到达这一点。没有人会取消足球的地图化。但这也许可以解释为什么当一个看起来俏皮、有人情味且存在于网格之外的天才涌现时，每个人都会如此兴奋。这也解释了为什么过早对马克斯·道曼大加赞赏会让人感觉不对劲，并担心给他带来魔咒。我们知道这是怎么回事。这是一个毛茸茸的新东西。让我们摧毁他。让我们把压力压在他的肩膀上。不要谈论马克斯·道曼。让马克斯·道曼存在、呼吸并在阴影中绽放。
那么，说说马克斯·道曼吧。现在要忽视他变得相当困难。他在周中的比赛中对阵伊普斯威奇时表现出色，这种出色显得扎实、真实且内心笃定。最明显的是那两个进球，这两个进球都是完美的快照，解释了为什么道曼似乎具备生存的能力，比我们赋予期望的其他一些年轻球员更具现代感。
第二个进球格外精彩，在六秒钟的足球比赛中包含了五个完美的微小动作。阿森纳在伊普斯威奇禁区边缘控球。道曼寻求传球，发现球传向别处，改变了主意，并进行了三码的冲刺来创造空间。最终，他在那个狭小的空间里具备了控制弹地球的身体能力，其挪动双脚的速度比最近的防守球员快得多，看起来就像机器出了故障，并且能够通过筛选选项和掌握射门时机的方式完成破门，而且全程步伐没有丝毫停顿。
第一个进球在她的另一侧，涉及更经典的一对一欺骗。这是同一名防守球员：塞德里克·基普雷，29岁，出自巴黎圣日耳曼青训营。道曼通过一次微假动作和脚法切换轻松过掉了他，随后又完成了一次令人捧腹的低调射门，这一切发生时，第二名防守球员还在调整身体准备扑抢，就像一个在与周围所有人处于不同时空节奏中运作的人。
这是关键的区别所在，这种让一切都停下来的能力，这种飞行般的视野意味着当其他所有人都在疯狂旋转试图解读图表时，他能看到即将发生的事情，就像莱昂内尔·梅西（是的，对不起，对不起）总是似乎有时间把球传进球门一样，就好像这一切只是穿着拖鞋在踢野球一样。
我们理解年轻创造型球员的方式似乎总是滞后于比赛的实际现状，并受到对过去事物怀旧情绪的驱使。我记得当18岁的杰克·罗德威尔的身体素质在身体素质不再重要的那一刻引发轰动时，就像在福特T型车刚下生产线时自豪地展示最新的马车火车一样。
迈克尔·欧文在17岁时就非常出色，但他主要的出色之处在于直线跑得非常快并将球轰入球网。当然还有韦恩·鲁尼，他作为一个面色苍白、尚未成型的青少年出现，完全由能量饮料和白面包组成，在场上即兴发挥，就像某种城市弃儿嘴里还叼着一串香肠越过广告牌狂奔而来一样。
围绕鲁尼的叙事是他失去了这种至关重要的本土特质。但鲁尼适应并生存了下来，并且显然比我们这些旁观者更清楚他必须成为什么样的人。即使在现在，创造型球员也必须在这种环境下生存。科尔·帕尔默令人兴奋，因为他做出了令人惊讶的事情，似乎在为自由、美以及那些电子邮件运行困难的老年人进行抗争。但他真正的挑战是在适应周围世界的同时，保留足够多的这种特质。
道曼则有些不同。让他脱颖而出的特质似乎非常契合现代足球的发展方向。现代创造型足球运动员不是花哨的盘带、刺耳的抽射，也不是穿着牛仔靴在菜地里盘带。而是有针对性的能量、高强度的半自由。亚马尔和杜埃拥有相同的快速应变脚法和头脑速度，具备在微观时刻运作的能力，能够在稍早前看到比赛的规律。道曼身高六英尺，而且身体变得更强壮了。他不会被踢得支离破碎。他可以重复这一点而不会消耗自己。
年轻仍然是个问题。但也许这也不是那么重要。世界已经变了。在鲁尼和欧文的时代，没有关怀，没有数据，没有温情。这就是现代足球结构发挥优势的地方。道曼将被精确到小数点后最后一位的GPS定位。无休止的体能科学家将对他的输出和压力水平发表意见。
资金太庞大了。天赋太宝贵了。它也做好了即插即用的准备。你若不具备吸收战术体系和简报的能力，就无法达到这个水平。你已经被高压烹调和压力测试过了。在职业足球有序的空间里被要求做的事情，和你在学院足球有序的空间里被要求做的事情是一样的，只是级别更高，有更多的人在观看。
博尔赫斯反足球是因为他认为足球是不真实的，球员不再是运动员，而是“电视摄像机前的球衣演员”。这也是可以理解的，这进一步证明了嬉皮士老爸式的怀旧是人类行为的关键原型之一。
生活现在也不同了；不是更难或更容易，而是更加瞬息万变，是一系列瞬间，是快速爆发能量的创造。道曼就是在这种环境下长大的。他可以分配自己的时间，消失一会儿，也许在春天大显身手。
是的，这也是将他纳入某种模版、将未来马克斯·道曼的等大地图铺在现实之上的另一种方式。但我坚信他会没事的，与外界许多其他事物不同，他非常适应未来的模样。

items.titleEn: U21s report: Birmingham City 0-0 Arsenal
items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners were held to a frustrating stalemate against Birmingham City in the Premier League 2
bodyEn: Our under-21s were held to a frustrating 0-0 draw by Birmingham City at the Knighthead Training and Academy Grounds on Friday afternoon.

We created a host of opportunities in the first half, but were denied time and time again by home goalkeeper Tyrese Warmington, who made particularly good saves from Andre Harriman-Annous and Josh Ogunnaike.
Despite further chances after the break, the best of which fell to Elijah Upson and Maalik Hashi, we had to settle for a point.
FIRST HALF

We made a bright start at the Knighthead Training Ground and came close to an early goal when James Scanlon picked out Josh Ogunnaike on the left, who forced a quick reaction save from Tyrese Warmington in the Blues' goal.
Ceadach O'Neill was next to have a go, firing a powerful effort towards the bottom corner from 20 yards, only for Warmington to get down quickly to his right.

Our Gunners continued to mount the pressure on in the early stages, and had another near miss when Andre Harriman-Annous' first-time strike from just inside the penalty area did beat Warmington, but hit the bottom of the post.

Harriman-Annous came close to break the deadlock once again on the half-hour mark, forcing a stunning reaction save from Warmington from a sweetly struck volley after the Birmingham goalkeeper had tipped a cross off the head of Ife Ibrahim.

Right at the end of the half, Harriman-Annous caused problems for the hosts again, picking out O'Neill on the edge of the box, who saw his effort saved. Ogunnaike then arrived on the follow-up, but saw his shot on the rebound smothered by Warmington, who capped an excellent half with yet another crucial save.
SECOND HALF
We picked up where we left off after the break and had another big chance with our first set-piece of the second half, with Elijah Upson's header landing the wrong side of the post.
The hosts created their first opportunity of the game after 55 minutes when Finn McGreevy darted down the right wing and fired a powerful effort just over the crossbar from a tight angle.

After a triple change, which saw Evan Mooney, Igor Tyjon and Archie Stevens all introduced, Mooney forced another save from Warmington before Hashi's rebound effort from the edge of the box was also beaten away by the Birmingham no.1.
The final 30 minutes of the game brought few chances with little to do for either goalkeeper.

There was one final chance for our young Gunners when a long ball dropped to Tyjon 20 yards out, but the striker missed out on his first Arsenal goal by a couple of inches as his curling effort dropped just wide of the post, with what was the final kick of the game.
WHAT IT MEANS
Our third draw in four Premier League 2 games means we head into the first international break of the season with three points on the board.
WHAT'S NEXT
Our young Gunners head to an international window for the next three weeks, with several players in action for their respective countries, both at youth and senior levels.
After the extended break, we'll be back at Mangata Developments Stadium to face Sunderland on Saturday, October 10 for a 1pm (UK) kick-off.
LINE-UPS
Arsenal XI: Ranson, Hamill (Mbala, 46'), Ogunnaike, Clarke, Upson, Ibrahim, O'Neill (Stevens, 60'), Julienne (Tyjon, 60'), Harriman-Annous, Hashi (Agustien, 73'), Scanlon (Mooney, 60')
Subs: Porter, Nwaneri
Birmingham City XI: Warmington, Thomas-Jones (Campbell, 90+1'), Chahal, Burrell, Quirk, Maddox, Bamba (Da Silva, 58'), Martin-Moore (Hawkeswood, 67'), Reilly (Ugorji, 67'), Elmansuri, McGreevy

items.titleZh: U21联赛战报：伯明翰城 0-0 阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳U21在英超2中客场战平伯明翰城。
bodyZh: 周五下午，我们的U21青年队在奈特黑德训练学院球场以0-0的平局与伯明翰城握手言和。
我们在上半场创造了大量得分机会，但一次次被主队门将泰雷塞·沃明顿（Tyrese Warmington）化解，其中他神勇扑出了安德烈·哈里曼-安努斯（Andre Harriman-Annous）和乔什·奥古奈克（Josh Ogunnaike）的几次极具威胁的射门。
尽管中场休息后我们创造了更多机会，其中最好的两次机会分别由埃利贾·厄普森（Elijah Upson）和马利克·哈希（Maalik Hashi）获得，但我们最终只能接受一场平局。
上半场
我们在奈特黑德训练基地开局良好，詹姆斯·斯坎伦（James Scanlon）在左路找到了乔什·奥古奈克，后者险些早早破门，但他的射门被伯明翰门将泰雷塞·沃明顿迅速做出反应化解。
接着是塞达奇·奥尼尔（Ceadach O'Neill）尝试射门，他在20码处轰出一记劲射直奔远角，但沃明顿迅速向右倒地将球扑出。
我们的青年军在开场阶段持续施压，安德烈·哈里曼-安努斯在禁区边缘的一次直接射门越过了沃明顿，但击中了立柱下沿，险些破门。
比赛进行到半小时左右，哈里曼-安努斯再次险些打破僵局。伯明翰门将此前将一记传中从伊费·易卜拉欣（Ife Ibrahim）头顶破坏，哈里曼-安努斯随后接队友美妙的传中凌空抽射，逼迫沃明顿做出了一次精彩的反应扑救。
在上半场即将结束时，哈里曼-安努斯再次为主队防线制造麻烦，他在禁区边缘找到奥尼尔，后者的射门被扑出。奥古奈克随后跟进补射，但被沃明顿稳稳抱住，沃明顿用又一次关键扑救为他出色的上半场画上了句号。
下半场
我们在下半场延续了此前的攻势，并凭借下半场的第一次定位球制造了巨大威胁，埃利贾·厄普森的头球攻门稍稍偏出立柱外侧。
比赛进行到55分钟时，主队创造了全场第一记机会，芬恩·麦格里维（Finn McGreevy）沿右路突进，在小角度轰出一脚极具威胁的射门，稍稍高出横梁。
在经历了一次连换三人（埃万·穆尼、伊戈尔·蒂琼和阿奇·史蒂文斯替补登场）后，穆尼迫使沃明顿再次做出扑救，随后哈希在禁区边缘的补射也被伯明翰一门化解。
比赛最后的30分钟机会寥寥，双方门将都没有受到太多考验。
我们的年轻枪手在比赛结束前迎长传找到了禁区外20码处的蒂琼，这位前锋距离自己的首粒阿森纳进球只有几英寸之遥，他的兜射稍稍偏出立柱，这也是全场比赛的最后一脚射门。
比赛意义
这是我们在四场英超2比赛中的第三场平局，这意味着我们带着三个积分迎来了本赛季的第一个国际比赛日。
接下来
我们的青年军将在接下来的三周迎来国际比赛窗口期，多名球员将分别代表各自的国家队（包括青年队和成年队）出战。
在经历漫长的间歇期后，我们将于10月10日星期六重返曼加塔发展球场迎战桑德兰，比赛将于英国时间下午1点开球。
双方阵容
阿森纳首发：兰森、哈米尔（姆巴拉，46'）、奥古奈克、克拉克、厄普森、易卜拉欣、奥尼尔（史蒂文斯，60'）、朱利安（蒂琼，60'）、哈里曼-安努斯、哈希（阿古斯蒂恩，73'）、斯坎伦（穆尼，60'）
替补：波特、恩瓦内里
伯明翰城首发：沃明顿、托马斯-琼斯（坎贝尔，90+1'）、查哈尔、伯勒尔、奎克、马多克斯、班巴（达席尔瓦，58'）、马丁-穆尔（霍克斯伍德，67'）、雷利（乌戈尔吉，67'）、埃尔曼苏里、麦格里维
替补：史密斯

items.titleEn: Preview: Arsenal Women v Manchester United
items.summaryEn: We look to get back to winning ways in the Women’s Super League with the visit of Manchester United at Emirates Stadium on Saturday evening.
bodyEn: We look to return to winning ways in the Women’s Super League as Manchester United visit Emirates Stadium on Saturday evening (5.30pm UK).

We’ll play for our first home win of the season in N5 after last weekend’s 0-0 draw with Crystal Palace, which saw us move to four points after our opening two WSL matches, while United head to north London still looking for their first.

Tickets remain on general sale, so get yours now to avoid missing out. Supporters can enjoy a pre-match pitchside DJ set with Lens LDN from 4.10pm to 4.30pm and 4.45pm to 5.15pm, while our Fan First Offers include a pint of Asahi Super Dry for £4.50 - find out more.
SLOW START FOR OLID

Spanish manager Eva Olid took over as United’s head coach in the summer, replacing the departing Marc Skinner, but it’s not been a good start for the new boss. After drawing 1-1 away to Leicester City in pre-season, United were beaten by Newcastle United, Liverpool and Manchester City ahead of the league campaign.
Top-flight football began with a 2-1 defeat away to London City Lionesses, followed by a 5-0 home loss to Chelsea last weekend, which rooted them at the bottom of the division.

Seven players were recruited in the summer, namely Phoebe Lear, Erin Baxter, Andrea Medina, Hollie Stone-Armstrong, Janina Leitzi, Monica Jusu Bah and Rebeca Bernal, while 13 players left the club on permanent transfers.
WHAT THE MANAGERS SAY
Slegers: “The best thing is always to get back onto the grass and execute. I think psychologically that's good as well for everyone to be able to action things. So we've looked at some things.

"Of course, we were happy with our dominance in the game [against Palace] and our entries in the final third, entries in the box, amount of shots, but we've also been looking at how we can create even bigger opportunities for ourselves when the spaces are really tight and there's a lot of bodies in the box.”
Olid: “My main message is about being themselves. I think they’re not showing in the first two matches who they are and what they can do.
“We had a day to reflect, analyse the game, see what we can do better and I think we know what we have to do, which is important this Saturday.”
TEAM NEWS
Daphne van Domselaar, Michelle Agyemang and Katie Reid remain unavailable for this weekend, while Elisa de Almeida has also picked up an injury.

Going into more detail on Van Domselaar, Slegers said: "October is in our minds somewhere [for her return], but we still have to look at how the new response is. Day by day, there is a plan in place, but that plan has been changed several times now. October will be great, but let's see where it goes. Daphne is working really hard in the background with the medical team."

United will make a late call on Andrea Medina, who came off in the second half of Sunday's defeat to Chelsea, while right-back Jayde Riviere missed the meeting with the Blues due to calf problems. Young midfielder Emma Watson was also sidelined and will be out for a few weeks.
Fridolina Rolfo recently shared the news of her pregnancy, while Celin Bizet Donnum - who gave birth in June - is back in training.
FACTS AND STATS
We are unbeaten in each of our last six WSL meetings with Manchester United (W2 D4), though we drew both matchups last term 0-0.

We are unbeaten in 19 WSL games and could set our outright longest unbeaten streak in the competition this weekend (W14 D5). We also remain unbeaten at home under Renee Slegers in the top-flight (W16 D4) and could equal the third-longest home run without defeat overall in the WSL (Manchester City between November 2021 and October 2023).
Manchester United have won just one of their six WSL away games against us (D2 L3), a 3-2 win in November 2022 at Emirates Stadium with Alessia Russo scoring the winning goal in stoppage time.

Manchester United have lost their opening two league games for the first time since their debut WSL campaign in 2019/20; the Red Devils have also shipped a league-high seven goals, never previously conceding more than three times across their first two matches of a top-flight season.

Chelsea’s Keira Walsh (19) is the only midfielder involved in more shot-ending open-play sequences than Georgia Stanway (17) and Mariona Caldentey (16) in the WSL this season. Stanway also leads all midfielders for successful passes in 2026/27 (194).
REF WATCH
Abigail Byrne has been appointed to take charge of Saturday’s match. She has seen over five games across the Women’s Super League, League One, League Two and National League so far this season.
Her last involvement in one of our games was February’s 1-0 home win over Manchester City.

夏天引进了七名球员，分别是菲比·莱尔、埃琳·巴克斯特、安德烈亚·梅迪纳、霍莉·斯通-阿姆斯特朗、扬娜·莱特齐、莫妮卡·茹苏·巴和丽贝卡·伯纳尔，同时有13名球员永久转会离队。
主教练言论
斯莱格斯：“最好的事情总是回到草坪上并执行战术。我认为从心理上讲，这对每个人能够付诸行动也是有好处的。所以我们看了一些事情。”
“当然，我们在对阵水晶宫的比赛中展现的统治力、进入前场的次数、进入禁区的次数以及射门次数让我们满意，但我们也一直在研究如何在空间非常狭窄、禁区内有很多人的情况下，为自己创造出更好的机会。”
奥利德：“我的主要信息是做回自己。我认为他们在前两场比赛中没有展现出他们是谁以及他们能做什么。”
“我们有一天的时间来反思、分析比赛，看看我们能做哪些改进，我认为我们知道我们必须做什么，这对于这个星期六很重要。”
球队消息
达芙妮·范多姆斯拉尔、米歇尔·阿杰芒和凯蒂·里德本周末仍无法出场，埃利萨·德阿尔梅达也遭遇了伤病。
在谈到范多姆斯拉尔的更多细节时，斯莱格斯说：“10月是我们心中的某个时间点（她复出），但我们仍需观察新的反应。每天都有一个既定的计划，但这个计划现在已经改变了好几次。10月会很棒，但让我们看看进展如何。达芙妮正在幕后与医疗团队非常努力地工作。”
曼联将对安德烈亚·梅迪纳做出最后决定，她在周日不敌切尔西的比赛下半场被换下，而右后卫杰德·里维埃由于小腿问题缺席了与切尔西的比赛。年轻中场埃玛·沃特森也因伤缺阵几周。
弗里多利娜·罗尔福最近分享了她怀孕的消息，而在6月分娩的塞林·比泽特·东努姆已恢复训练。
事实与数据
我们在最近六场对阵曼联的英超比赛中保持不败（2胜4平），尽管上赛季的两场交锋均以0-0战平。
我们在19场英超比赛中保持不败，本周末可能创造我们在该项赛事中的最长不败纪录（14胜5平）。我们在雷妮·斯莱格斯执教下的顶级联赛主场也保持不败（16胜4平），并可能追平英超历史上第三长的连续主场不败纪录（曼城在2021年11月至2023年10月之间创造）。
曼联在对阵我们的六个英超客场中只赢了一场（2平3负），那是2022年11月在酋长球场以3-2取胜，阿莱西亚·鲁索在补时阶段攻入制胜球。
曼联自2019/20赛季英超处子赛季以来首次遭遇联赛开局两连胜失利；红魔还丢了联赛最多的7个球，此前在顶级联赛赛季的前两场比赛中从未丢过超过3个球。
本赛季英超联赛中，切尔西的基拉·沃尔什（19次）是唯一一名参与终结进攻的运动战序列多于乔治娅·斯坦威（17次）和玛丽奥娜·卡尔登泰（16次）的中场球员。斯坦威在2026/27赛季的成功传球次数也领跑所有中场球员（194次）。
裁判执法
阿比盖尔·伯恩已被任命负责周六的比赛。本赛季她已经在女子超级联赛、英格兰甲级联赛、英格兰乙级联赛和国家联赛中执法了五场以上的比赛。
她上一次执法我们的比赛是2月主场1-0战胜曼城。
裁判：阿比盖尔·伯恩；助理裁判：阿纳斯塔西娅·沃洛舒克、鲁比·赛克斯；第四官员：苏菲·丹宁顿
如何观看
英国球迷可以通过天空体育直播观看这场比赛，并可查看其他国家和地区的转播机构。

items.titleEn: Every word from Arteta's pre-Brighton presser
items.summaryEn: Hear what Mikel Arteta has to say before our trip to the south coast to face Brighton & Hove Albion at the Amex Stadium in the Premier League
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has spoken to the press ahead of our final match before the extended international break against Brighton & Hove Albion.
We're looking to continue our perfect start to the campaign, and the boss has been speaking about our winning start, taking on the Seagulls and much more.
Read every word below, with a video of the full press conference to follow.
on how Ben White is:Ben is all good, we have another training session this afternoon, so very positive about everybody.
on if he’s positive about Timber, Mosquera and Hincapie:Yes, we have another session; they are all willing to be part of it. We have another session to try to make sure they are fit.

on if he’s now able to influence referees by calling out mistakes:No, I think I’m here to try to give my opinion, to defend my club, to give the very best to our players. In order to do so, obviously you guys can ask some questions, and we need to respond in the most direct way, I think, and fair way. I will make mistakes sometimes but I will try to be as fair as possible.

on wanting officials to get decisions right:We discuss many topics in this room and they’re important, all of them. We have a space to talk, to give our opinions, to have discussions, to have personal conversations. It’s everybody’s duty to try to improve the game and that’s what we’re here for.
on if we’ve heard from Pro Ref:These are conversations that will remain private, as usual, and they have to be kept that way.

on if he’d like an apology regarding the penalty at Sunderland:It’s not about the apology; it’s just agreeing whether the decision should have been different or not. Maybe [Pro Ref] have a different opinion. Let's try to improve and move forward together.

on Fabian Hurzeler providing an apology after our last game at Brighton:That’s all done, that’s all in the past. I have huge respect for Fabian, what he’s done and what Brighton have done as a club, it’s just remarkable. Tomorrow is going to be a beautiful game to watch, I’m sure.

on the potential to go eight wins in a row in all competitions:We've got a really tough opponent tomorrow, so we're going to have to really earn the right to win the game, but certainly that will be the mindset of the players and the team.
on if he’s going to sign a new contract:I think we are all very much aligned; whenever the time is right, we'll get that done. There is nothing to be concerned about.

on signing a contract two years ago during the international break:I don't know if the timing will be the same or different, I think we both have the same ambition and the same will, so whenever we have time we'll get that resolved.

on if he’s happy with the new longer break:Let's see, it's something that we'll have to experience. As you've seen, different national teams, different managers have taken different approaches in terms of the numbers that they have put in the squad, so it's going to be really important to have good communication with them, so they understand where our players are, what we expect, what they expect as well, and work together. That's always the best way.

on the mentality of the team when they consistently have to impose themselves away from home: That's one of the challenges of the schedule, and the team has responded so well. Playing with dominance, it doesn't really matter if we play at home or away, we want to be the same team and we want to cause the same kind of problems to the opposition. We have managed to win the three games, and we've got the last one against a really tough opponent, as I said, against Brighton tomorrow, and we'll try to do the same.

on if the onus is on our leadership group to support younger players:You cannot coach that. I think you have it or you don't, because it's a split-second, a very emotional reaction when you are in the middle of the game, and I absolutely loved it, because we've all been there, and just encouraging the confidence that it gives to a 16-year-old to go again and deliver in the next action, it's huge. I think he has mentioned it already, and it's good to see that bond, that connection within the team to try to help each other.

on if Guimaraes is predominantly a left or right midfielder:He can play on the left, on the right, in the middle, he can rotate from there. He's such a dynamic, versatile player that he can deliver great moments in any position, and it will be more down to what we need on the day, the relationship we have with the other midfielders, and for sure what the opponent does as well.

on how Raya has come from the National League to become one of the best goalkeepers in the world: That's a great story, I think for any kid as well, to look at trajectories and pathways, and how you can reach the highest level in football, and always maintaining that will, that motivation, and that enthusiasm that it can happen. Football now, especially internationally, is so connected that you never know, you might be playing a game, somebody scouts you, and you can end up in two or three years' time playing at the highest level. David, I think it's his mentality. Obviously he has tremendous quality, but he has overcome a lot of difficulties, a lot of challenges, to reach this point. When he reached this point, it wasn't easy in the beginning; he really had to dig in and prove himself, and with all the coaches, with Inaki [Cana] especially, doing amazing work with him daily, and all his teammates, he has earned the right to be one of the best now.

on if he’s been Mikel’s best signing:I don’t know - he’s been a tremendous signing, there’s no question about that. Whether he’s been the best or not, it’s just an opinion, but it doesn’t matter, we are so happy to have him. He’s helped take the team and the club to a different level, and now we need to maintain that level.

on if this type of international break could be better for momentum:Let’s see how it pans out. I think every national team is different - some play in Europe and others travel the world for two and a half weeks, so we have to wait and see how it goes.

on if this team could be another Invincibles:We just have enough on the plate today to prepare for the game against a really good Brighton tomorrow. We know how tough that’s going to be to earn the right to win it, that’s it.

on if Gyokeres is struggling for confidence:No, obviously, especially in the Premier League he hasn’t played that many minutes, but last week in Napoli he played and had a good game. That’s about moments as well, we need to give him all the support and confidence that he needs because we know the player we have, the capacity he has to score goals and what he can give to the team.

on if the team are still adapting to him or if he’s adapting to them:I think the team are doing certain different things this season as well, so it’s a bit of both. But that’s not just for Viktor; it’s for everybody - it’s the constant evolution of the player and team. Our job, and especially my job, is to try to fit that in and find those connections and level of confidence for the player to give his best for the team.

on if a change in environment is good for him after his past exploits with Sweden:He scored a few goals [last time]. That’s what a striker needs, they need minutes and goals to boost their energy. We have a game tomorrow, and hopefully he can deliver then.

on investing in young players from around the world:It’s us as a club, we know we want to constantly maintain this level and have the pathway already in-house - which is obviously the best way to bring players from the academy or youth teams to us. We need to be one of the best in the world at recruiting in the country and abroad to maintain that level.

on when young players are tempted by moves away to other big clubs:It is challenging because there are a lot of parties there and the way the system is at the top, it’s not easy. There are certain moments in those years when there are gaps where those big decisions need to be made, and they have the choice to make that decision as well. Something is not only what we want to do, it’s what the player, agent or family wants to do at times as well. That’s not easy, but we’ll for sure try to keep the best talent in-house.

on if he’s been surprised by how well we’ve started the season:We know how complicated it is to win a football match at this level, so to win seven, it tells the story. After the World Cup especially, there were a lot of unknowns about how the players and the team were going to react. We didn't have any time with them to work together, but as I said, they won. I've seen their attitude, and what I was seeing, I was really impressed with. Then you have to put it down to performances and the element of luck as well to win football matches, and we are here and then we want to make another one for sure tomorrow.

on if Dowman is asking to start more matches:That's the best way to knock on the door - to do it on the pitch, not in the office. I think with that you're just left out of arguments when a player delivers constantly on the pitch every single day in training. That's the best way, that's the best signal for the manager, that's the best signal for his teammates as well that they will demand that player play and what Max did the other day amongst all the players as well that haven't played that many minutes, was really impressive.

on what Eze brings to the left wing:He's always played there in his career; that's where all his biggest moments in his career and the highlights have come, and I think it's a place that he feels very, very, very comfortable. He can occupy different spaces through them but that's the space that generally he has created big moments for previous clubs as well to win matches.
on how to decide if Eze or Tzolis should start:In form, in the opponent, in the relationship that we have within that unit, there are a lot of factors.

on the impression Konsa has made so far and his link-up with Gabriel:I heard some great things about Ezri before he joined, and when you have him daily, you just realise the magnitude of the player that we signed - not only the player but the person, the way he presents himself, the way he's able to connect with people immediately. We talk about Big Gabi, when you see those two in the corridors talking, the way they interact with each other, it seems like they've been here for a long, long, long time together. That is great because that's a partnership that, in my opinion, is extremely important on the field, and then his attributes, the quality that he delivers to the team are something that really makes us better.

on how Dowman is developing as a person by being around the first team:In a really great way as well. When you see how those players behave daily, you know the level of attention they put into any detail, the way they look after themselves, the standard that they set. If you become part of that environment, that's only going to raise your level. It's going to educate you in a way that becomes normal and then you will hit another level because then you will be able to add to that. That's where Max is at the moment.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赛前新闻发布会重点内容
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔谈客战布莱顿、球员伤情及球队近况。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔在对阵布莱顿的比赛前接受了媒体采访，这也是漫长国际比赛日前的最后一战。
我们希望延续本赛季完美的开局，主教练谈到了球队的连胜开局、对阵海鸥军团以及更多话题。
请阅读下方的全部内容，稍后将提供完整新闻发布会的视频。
关于本·怀特的身体情况：本一切都很好，我们今天下午还有另一堂训练课，所以对每个人都非常乐观。
关于他对廷贝尔、莫斯奎拉和因卡皮耶是否保持乐观：是的，我们还有一堂训练课；他们都愿意参与其中。我们还有另一堂训练课来确保他们完全康复。
关于他现在是否能通过指出裁判错误来施加影响：不，我认为我在这里是试图表达我的观点，捍卫我的俱乐部，为我们的球员做到最好。为了做到这一点，显然你们可以提出一些问题，我们需要以最直接、最公平的方式做出回应。我有时会犯错，但我会尽量保持公平。
关于希望裁判做出正确判罚：我们在房间里讨论了许多话题，它们都很重要。我们有一个空间来交谈、发表意见、进行讨论和进行个人对话。尽力改进比赛是每个人的责任，这也是我们来这里的目的。
关于我们是否听取了职业裁判公司的意见：这些对话将像往常一样保持私密，必须保持这种状态。
关于他是否希望就桑德兰比赛中的点球获得道歉：这不是道歉的问题；这只是就是否应该做出不同的判罚达成一致。也许[职业裁判公司]有不同的看法。让我们一起努力改进并向前迈进。
关于法比安·赫尔泽勒在我们上一次在布莱顿的比赛后道歉：这一切都结束了，都成了过去。我对法比安、他所做的一切以及布莱顿作为一个俱乐部的成就怀有极大的敬意，这简直是了不起的。我相信明天的比赛一定会非常精彩。
关于各项赛事取得八连胜的潜力：我们明天将面对一个非常强大的对手，所以我们要靠自己的努力赢得比赛，但这肯定是球员和全队的精神面貌。
关于他是否会签新合同：我认为我们大家的意见非常一致；无论什么时候时机成熟，我们都会完成它。没有什么需要担心的。
关于两年前在国际比赛日期间签约：我不知道时间安排是否会相同，我认为我们都有相同的雄心和意愿，所以无论什么时候我们有时间，我们都会解决这个问题。
关于他对新的更长假期的看法：让我们拭目以待，这是我们需要亲身体验的事情。正如你所看到的，不同的国家队、不同的主教练在阵容人数上采取了不同的方法，因此与他们保持良好的沟通非常重要，这样他们才能了解我们的球员在哪里，我们的期望是什么，他们的期望是什么，然后共同努力。这永远是最好的方式。
关于球队在客场不断需要展现统治力时的心态：这是赛程的挑战之一，球队的反应非常好。带着统治力踢球，我们在主场还是客场踢其实并不重要，我们想要成为同一支球队，我们想要给对手制造同样的问题。我们已经赢得了三场比赛，正如我所说，明天我们将对阵一个非常强大的布莱顿，我们将尽力做到同样的事情。
关于领导小组是否有责任支持年轻球员：这是无法通过教练教出来的。我认为你要么有这种特质，要么没有，因为这是比赛进行中电光石火间非常情绪化的反应，我绝对喜欢它，因为我们都经历过，这给一个16岁球员带来的信心是巨大的，能让他再次挺身而出并在下一次行动中发挥作用。我想他已经提到了这一点，很高兴看到球队内部这种凝聚力和联系，大家试图互相帮助。
关于吉马良斯主要是左中场还是右中场：他可以踢左路、右路、中路，他可以从这些位置进行轮换。他是一名充满活力、全能的球员，能够在任何位置奉献精彩表现，这更多取决于我们在当天的需求、我们与其他中场球员的默契，当然还有对手的行动。

关于拉亚如何从全国联赛一步步成长为世界最佳门将之一：这是一个伟大的故事，我认为对于任何孩子来说，也是如此，去看看职业生涯的轨迹和途径，以及你如何能够达到足球的最高水平，并始终保持那种意愿、动力和热情，坚信这一切会发生。现在的足球，尤其是国际赛场，联系如此紧密，以至于你永远不知道，你可能正在踢一场比赛，有人在考察你，两三年后你就会在最高水平的赛场上踢球。大卫，我认为是他的心态。显然他拥有极高的素质，但他克服了许多困难、许多挑战才走到这一步。当他到达这一步时，一开始并不容易；他真的必须咬紧牙关证明自己，在所有教练的帮助下，特别是伊纳基[卡纳]每天对他的惊人工作，以及他所有的队友，他赢得了现在成为最佳球员之一的权利。
关于他是否是米克尔最佳签约：我不知道——他绝对是一次极好的签约，毫无疑问。至于他是不是最好的，这只是一种意见，但这并不重要，我们非常高兴拥有他。他帮助球队和俱乐部达到了不同的水平，现在我们需要保持这个水平。
关于这种国际比赛日是否有助于保持势头：让我们看看结果如何。我认为每个国家队都不同——有些在欧洲比赛，而另一些则要在两周半的时间里环游世界，所以我们必须等待并观察情况。
关于这支球队能否成为另一个不败之师：我们今天有足够的事情要做，那就是为明天对阵一支非常出色的布莱顿的比赛做好准备。我们知道要赢得胜利会有多艰难，就是这样。
关于约克雷斯是否在为找回信心而挣扎：没有，显然，特别是在英超联赛中他没有踢那么多分钟，但上周在那不勒斯他踢了比赛并且表现不错。这也是关于时机的问题，我们需要给他所有的支持和信心，因为我们了解这名球员，他进球的能力以及他能为球队带来的贡献。
关于球队是否还在适应他，或者他是否在适应球队：我认为球队本赛季也在做一些不同的事情，所以两者兼有。但这不仅对维克托如此；对每个人都是如此——这是球员和球队的不断进化。我们的工作，尤其是我的工作，就是试图将其融入其中，并找到这些联系和信心水平，让球员为球队发挥出最佳水平。
关于环境的改变对他来说是否在经历瑞典的征程后是一件好事：他进了一些球[上次]。这就是前锋需要的，他们需要出场时间和进球来提升能量。我们明天有一场比赛，希望他能有出色的表现。
关于投资来自世界各地的年轻球员：作为一家俱乐部，我们知道我们想要不断保持这个水平，并在内部拥有现成的培养途径——这显然是将学院或青年队球员带到我们这里的最好方式。我们需要成为国内和国外招募工作世界上最好的俱乐部之一，以维持这一水平。
关于年轻球员受到其他大俱乐部转会诱惑时：这具有挑战性，因为有很多方参与其中，而且顶层的运作系统使得事情并不容易。在这些年里，有某些时刻会出现真空期，需要做出重大决定，他们也可以选择做出这个决定。有些事情不仅是我们想做什么，也是球员、经纪人或家庭有时想做什么。这并不容易，但我们肯定会努力把最好的人才留在队内。
关于他对我们本赛季的出色开局是否感到惊讶：我们知道在这个水平上赢一场足球比赛有多么复杂，所以能赢七场，就说明了问题。特别是世界杯之后，关于球员和球队将如何反应有很多未知数。我们没有时间和他们一起工作，但正如我所说，他们赢了。我看到了他们的态度，我所看到的让我印象深刻。然后你必须把这归结为场上的表现以及赢得足球比赛的运气成分，我们现在在这里，明天我们肯定想再赢一场。
关于道曼是否要求获得更多首发机会：这是敲门的最好方式——在球场上展现出来，而不是在办公室里。我认为当一名球员每天在训练中在球场上持续有出色表现时，你就无话可说了。那是最好的方式，是对主教练最好的信号，也是对队友最好的信号，队友们会要求这位球员上场，马克斯和其他没有踢太多分钟的球员那天所做的一切，真的令人印象深刻。
关于埃泽能为左翼带来什么：在他的职业生涯中他一直踢那个位置；那是他职业生涯中所有最伟大时刻和高光表现诞生的切入点，我认为这是一个让他感到非常、非常、非常舒适的位置。他可以通过这些位置占据不同的空间，但那是他通常为前俱乐部创造赢得比赛的重大时刻的空间。
关于如何决定让埃泽还是措利斯首发：状态、对手、我们与该战术单元内部的默契，有很多因素决定。

关于孔萨迄今为止留下的印象以及他与加布里埃尔的搭档：在埃兹里加盟之前我听到了一些关于他的极好评价，当你每天与他相处时，你就会意识到我们签下的这名球员的分量——不仅是球员，还有他的人品、他展现自己的方式、他能够立即与人沟通的方式。我们谈论大加比，当你看到这两个人在走廊里交谈，他们互动的方式，看起来他们好像已经在一起很长、很长、很长的时间了。这太棒了，因为在我看来，这是一个在球场上极其重要的搭档关系，然后他的属性、他为球队带来的品质确实让我们变得更好。
关于道曼作为一个人在跟随一线队期间是如何成长的：成长得非常好。当你看到这些球员每天的表现时，你就知道他们在任何细节上付出的注意力水平、他们照顾自己的方式、他们设定的标准。如果你成为那种环境的一部分，那只会提高你的水平。它会以一种变得正常的方式教育你，然后你将达到另一个水平，因为那时你将能够有所增益。这就是马克斯目前所处的阶段。
